extracted.intended_audience: senior/key personnel and other significant contributors preparing NIH-format biographical sketches for grant applications (researchers, research administrators)
extracted.subtask_description: Prepare a NIH-format biographical sketch for senior/key personnel and other significant contributors, following the required sections (Education/Training, Personal Statement, Positions, Contributions to Science, Research Support) and page limits for grant applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow required format and page limit
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the following information for the Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors. Follow this format for each person. DO NOT EXCEED FIVE PAGES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the exact sections and ordering shown on the form for each person and keep each individual biosketch to a maximum of five pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Name and eRA Commons user name
rubrics_metrics.description: NAME: (and) eRA COMMONS USER NAME (credential, e.g., agency login):
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the individual's full name and their eRA Commons user name credential where requested.

rubrics_metrics.name: Position title
rubrics_metrics.description: POSITION TITLE: (e.g., Associate Professor, Research Regulatory Specialist, Pre-Award Grant Specialist, etc.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the current position title that reflects the role being presented in the biosketch.

rubrics_metrics.name: Education/Training (begin with baccalaureate)
rubrics_metrics.description: EDUCATION/TRAINING (Begin with baccalaureate or other initial professional education, such as nursing, include postdoctoral training and residency training if applicable. Add/delete rows as necessary.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List institution and location, degree (if applicable), completion date (MM/YY or MM/YYYY), and field of study. Include all relevant training starting with the baccalaureate and include postdoctoral/residency training where applicable. Add or delete rows to accommodate the person's training history.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personal Statement
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarize training, experience, and how the individual's background and expertise make them well suited to contribute to the proposed project. Describe roles and planned contributions to the specific project (e.g., lead investigator, mentor, coordinator). Provide evidence of relevant experience (e.g., prior leadership of similar projects, teaching, capacity building) as justification for involvement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Positions and Employment
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a chronological list of positions and employment with dates and institutional affiliations (e.g., 1984-1986 Medical Officer, STD Clinic, Mulago Hospital). Include current and past relevant academic, managerial, and professional positions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Honors and Service (recent)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List honors, leadership roles, board memberships, advisory roles, and service activities, indicating dates and institutions; the form explicitly highlights listing those from the last five years.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contributions to Science
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide narrative descriptions of up to several major contributions to science, each followed by selected peer-reviewed references exemplifying the work. For each contribution describe the work's aims, findings, significance, and policy or practice implications where relevant. Use labeled sub-items (a., b., c., etc.) to list representative publications and provide context for their importance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Support (ongoing, pending, completed)
rubrics_metrics.description: D. Additional Information: Research Support and/or Scholastic Performance (Ongoing Research Support, Pending Research Support, Completed Research Support)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List current (ongoing), pending, and completed research support separately. For each entry include Project Number, funding Source, Title, Project Dates, Major Goals, and Role (e.g., Principal Investigator, Co-Investigator). Include calendar effort where relevant (e.g., .6 calendar). Follow the example entries showing project number, source, title, major goals, role, and dates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide complete citations for representative publications
rubrics_metrics.description: When listing publications under Contributions to Science, include full citations (authors, title, journal, year, volume(issue):pages) and, where useful, note the study group or consortium.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cite representative works that support the narrative contribution. The example shows formatted references and inclusion of consortium names (e.g., 'the Rakai Study Group'). Use these citations to substantiate claims about impact and findings.

rubrics_metrics.name: List relevant professional memberships and editorial/service roles
rubrics_metrics.description: Other Experience and Professional Memberships; Editorial Board memberships; advisory and committee roles
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document memberships, committee service, editorial board positions, and advisory roles with dates, to demonstrate community engagement and professional standing relevant to the project.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include URLs for full publication lists or relevant resources
rubrics_metrics.description: The URL to my full list of publications is below: http://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/?term=...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a link to an external, up-to-date publication list (e.g., PubMed) or institutional pages when appropriate to avoid exceeding page limits while giving reviewers access to the full record.
